description: Permanently deletes a status page with its settings, groups and custom-domain binding. Irreversible. To hide a page without deleting, use `status_page_publish` with `action = "unpublished"`.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

name: status_page_delete
title: Delete status page
